title: Frames ContentOS PR to Video Workflow v1
description: Workflow state for a code-change explainer video (GitHub PR to video, input is a code change via gh, no web capture, no footage). 8-step gated orchestrator delegating to Fase 2 capabilities. Style fixed code-editorial.

projectId.description: Project directory name (kebab-case from PR, e.g. acme-sdk-pr-1842). No workspace name or timestamp.

source_type.description: PR ref form. github-pr = URL or owner/repo#N. this-pr = PR in checked-out repo.

pr_ref.description: Normalized PR ref (owner/repo#N or N). State stores the normalized ref, never the raw https URL (URLs trigger network-in-workflow).

style.description: Fixed style. Always code-editorial (warm editorial, navy code surface for diffs). Never asked, never overridden.

duration_s.description: Target duration from brief length. Specialized workflows strong at 30-120s. >180s routes to general-video.

vo_mode.description: Verbatim = keep user wording. Restructured = reshape for narrative. Silent = no narration.

offline.description: Render-path offline-first. Compositions + TTS offline. Step 1 ingest uses gh (the one network step). State itself is offline (no https URLs).

silent.description: music: none + no SCRIPT. No narration, no BGM, no SFX.

rendered.description: true once renders/video.mp4 exists (RENDERED_DRAFT). finalize gate-passed without rendered=true = no-render violation.

user_gated.description: Steps setup, storyboard, finalize pause for user approval.

steps.description: 8-step workflow state. Each step must pass gate before next.
